extName: Tabazing: Visual Tab Switcher with Live Previews
extDesc: Alt+Tab for Chrome tabs: live previews, instant search and recently closed tabs. Free, private, nothing leaves your computer.
cmdOpen: Open Tabazing on the previous tab (let go of Alt to switch)
cmdReverse: Open Tabazing on the next tab (let go of Alt to switch)
cmdStay: Open Tabazing and keep it open
searchPlaceholder: Search open tabs and tabs closed in the last 7 days
noMatch: No open tabs match your search.
noStarredOpen: No open tabs are starred. Star one with the ☆ on its card.
sleepingTip: Sleeping: Chrome unloaded this tab to save memory. It reloads when you open it.
captureTitle: Shows this tab for a moment to take its picture, then comes back
pickTitle: Select. Shift+click a card to select a range.
dupesTitle: Show the pages that are open more than once (same address, ignoring the #part). You then choose to close the extra copies.
sweepAll: {count, plural, one {# without preview · Capture it} other {# without preview · Capture all}}
sweepThese: {count, plural, one {# without preview · Capture it} other {# without preview · Capture these}}
sweepFirst: {count, plural, other {# without preview · Capture first {max}}}
sweepTitleAll: Shows each of your tabs for a moment to take its picture, then puts you back where you were.
sweepTitleThese: Shows each of these tabs for a moment to take its picture, then puts you back where you were.
sweepTitleOne: You can also capture one tab from its card.
actFailed: That didn’t work. Chrome said no.
copyFailed: This page won’t let Tabazing use the clipboard. Try from the popup (New Tab page).
sleptNone: Nothing to put to sleep (Chrome won’t unload the tab you’re on).
tour3Body: Just type. Typos are fine. It finds open tabs, and ones you closed in the last 7 days.
tourManyBody: Tick tabs with the box (Shift+click ticks a range). Then close, copy, move or put them to sleep together from the bar at the bottom.
askTitle: How is Tabazing working for you?
askBody: Ten seconds. It tells me what to build next. Your answer stays on your computer; the buttons only open a page where you choose what to send.
askGoodBody: A review is the best way to help other people find Tabazing.
askBadBody: Tell me what would make it work for you. A review is welcome too, whenever you like.
reviewBtn: Review on the Chrome Web Store
askNote: Each opens in a new tab. Tabazing itself sends nothing.
hostBlocked: Chrome is keeping Tabazing away from your sites, so there are no previews yet.
hostBlockedTip: Chrome’s “Site access” for Tabazing isn’t set to “On all sites”. Without it Tabazing can’t take previews or hear Alt+Q on web pages.
hostThanks: Thanks. Tabazing can see your sites now. Previews fill in as you visit tabs.
capErrHost: Chrome isn’t letting Tabazing look at this page, so it has no picture. Allowing Tabazing on all sites usually fixes that.
capErrPage: Chrome doesn’t allow pictures of this kind of page.
capErrOther: Tabazing couldn’t take a picture of this page just now.
flyoutBody: Press {key} to see all your tabs.
flyoutSub: Or click the Tabazing icon in the toolbar.
nudgeBody: {key} shows all of them at once, with previews. Type to find one.
sweepNote: Each tab shows for a moment. You’ll be back where you were.
captureBlocked: Chrome doesn’t allow a preview of this page.
captureFailed: No preview this time: the page didn’t finish loading. Try again in a moment.
sleepLaterN: {count, plural, one {# tab will sleep when you leave Tabazing} other {# tabs will sleep when you leave Tabazing}}
sweepNothing: Nothing to capture: every tab here already has a preview, or can’t have one.
actCloseTitle: Close the selected tabs. They stay under Recently closed.
actCopyTitle: Copy their addresses, one per line
actCopyMdTitle: Copy “- [Title](link)” lines: they paste as clickable titles in Notion, Obsidian, GitHub, Slack or Docs
selAllMatches: {count, plural, one {Select the matching tab} other {Select all # matching tabs}}
selAllTabs: {count, plural, one {Select the tab} other {Select all # tabs}}
dupesSummary: {count, plural, one {# extra copy: one tab of each page stays} other {# extra copies: one tab of each page stays}}
notePh: Write a note for this tab…
noteHint: Saved when you close this. Leave it empty to remove the note.
ageDays: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
tourSwitchBody: Hold Alt and press Q to go back through your tabs, W to go forward, or turn the mouse wheel. Let go of Alt to switch.
tourCardsBody: Star it, mute it, pin it, put it to sleep, copy its link, or leave yourself a note.
tourCardsMouse: Ctrl+click shows a big preview. Middle-click closes the tab.
tourSortBody: Recently opened first. Choose “By order” to see them as in the tab strip, and drag cards to move tabs. Pinned tabs always come first.
setAllWindowsNote: Off: only the window you open Tabazing in.
mergeN: {count, plural, one {Merge # window into this one} other {Merge # windows into this one}}
mergedN: {count, plural, one {Moved # tab into this window} other {Moved # tabs into this window}}
enterSearch: Press Enter to search Google for “{text}”.
noMatchShift: No open tabs match. Shift+Enter searches Google.
snoozedN: {count, plural, one {Snoozed # tab until {time}} other {Snoozed # tabs until {time}}}
snoozeCant: These pages can’t be reopened later.
ddNoMarks: Bookmarks can’t be searched yet: reload Tabazing at chrome://extensions to turn on its bookmarks access.
ddNoHistory: History can’t be searched yet: reload Tabazing at chrome://extensions to turn on its history access.
setStartupNote: Shows all your tabs, where you left off, a few seconds after Chrome opens.
shortcutMissing: Alt+Q isn’t set for Tabazing: another app or extension may have it. Pick a shortcut in Chrome.
iconTip: Tip: {key} opens Tabazing from anywhere, no mouse needed.
tourSetBody: Language, card size, accent colour, and opening Tabazing when Chrome starts.
archiveThis: Archive this tab (moves it to the “Tabs Archive” bookmarks folder)
archiveEmpty: No archived tabs yet. Archive a tab with the box button on its card.
archiveOpenTip: Open and take out of the archive: {title}
